about: The passage that settles a claim is on a fetched page but outside the excerpt the discovery query chose: a blog says Savings Plans do not apply, and the vendor's pricing page says they do, below a dozen node-price paragraphs that match the query. Excerpted by the claims being checked, the checker sees it.

findings.title: CacheCloud guide
findings.content: Our 2026 guide: Savings Plans do not apply to CacheCloud, so reserved nodes are the only discount.
